about: During duodenal ulcer maintenance at a creatinine clearance of 42 mL/min, nizatidine 150 mg was supplied daily instead of every two days.
possible finding: the record holds no line about creatinine clearance for nizatidine 150 mg twice daily during active ulcer treatment.
Nizatidine 150 mg daily for active ulcer treatment matches the regimen at a creatinine clearance of 50 mL/min.
